## Overview

Developed at **Fondazione Bruno Kessler (Digital Health Research)** (2023–2024) in collaboration with clinicians and psychologists, this project powers the **iEMBRACE** proof-of-concept and feasibility study in a long-term care facility.

## Technical Contribution

- Built a **Unity VR application** targeting the **Meta Quest** headset family for older adults experiencing cognitive decline and responsive behaviours.
- Designed relaxing, interactive virtual environments supporting **hand-gesture interaction** so residents can engage naturally without complex controllers.
- Developed a **companion smartphone application** enabling healthcare workers to supervise, customise, and control the VR session in real time.
